question: Calculate the overall average first round and average last round of races missed by Formula 1 drivers across all years. Include only drivers who missed fewer than three races in a given year and who switched teams between their appearances immediately before and after their hiatus (i.e., the constructor ID for the race right before their first missed race must be different from the constructor ID for the race right after their last missed race in that year). Do not group results by year; return just the overall averages across the entire dataset.
sql:
-- Let me also check if the question wants the averages per driver or overall.
-- "Calculate the overall average first round and average last round of races missed by Formula 1 drivers across all years."
-- "Do not group results by year; return just the overall averages across the entire dataset."
-- This means we average across all driver-year instances that meet the criteria.
-- 
-- But wait - could it mean we should average per driver first, then average across drivers?
-- Let me re-read: "overall average" suggests just one average across all instances.
-- The current query does exactly that - averages across all qualifying driver-year instances.
--
-- Let me also verify with the full result to make sure rounding is appropriate
SELECT 
  AVG(1.0 * h.first_missed) as avg_first_round_missed,
  AVG(1.0 * h.last_missed) as avg_last_round_missed
FROM (
  SELECT driver_id, year, first_round as first_missed, last_round as last_missed, 
         (last_round - first_round + 1) as races_missed
  FROM drives 
  WHERE constructor_id = -1
    AND (last_round - first_round + 1) < 3
) h
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT driver_id, year, constructor_id, first_round, last_round
  FROM drives
  WHERE constructor_id != -1
) ob ON h.driver_id = ob.driver_id AND h.year = ob.year
  AND ob.last_round = h.first_missed - 1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT driver_id, year, constructor_id, first_round, last_round
  FROM drives
  WHERE constructor_id != -1
) oa ON h.driver_id = oa.driver_id AND h.year = oa.year
  AND oa.first_round = h.last_missed + 1
WHERE ob.constructor_id IS NOT NULL 
  AND oa.constructor_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ob.constructor_id != oa.constructor_id
